derivation: The 8 points of the orchestrator's map census (scratchpad causeways.py). Causeway intervals: dry road stations with engine water within 30 m on both sides, 1 m stations, gaps <= 5 m closed, runs >= 60 m, on the basis terrain. Two independent derivations agree: causeway_v31 census (round 1 report) and the review 1 recensus (chain-and-classification.json: c0 chain 104 890-1507, c1 chain 62 87-475). The short runs of c2-c7 are the review 1 recensus on the same terrain.
